issues.explanation: Chapter 42 suddenly has Guan Yu arriving from Jiangxia with 10,000 troops and Kongming already arranging the Han津/Xia口 rescue. Chapter 41 never establishes that Guan Yu was sent to Jiangxia or that Kongming left the retreat to seek aid, so their timely intervention lacks causal setup.
issues.suggested_fix: Add at the end of Chapter 41 that Guan Yu was sent to Jiangxia for Liu Qi's aid, and that Kongming subsequently went to Jiangxia/Xia口 to coordinate the rescue; or briefly establish these actions at the start of Chapter 42.
